title: Unified exposure tables by admin unit
description: Crop, livestock and human-population exposure summed to admin 0/1/2. The denominator behind every hazard-exposure percentage.

transfer.rationale: One 0.4.4 run from inputs that are all pull-from-origin.

gaps: Chosen as the cross-host equivalence proof for issue #29 because every input is pull-from-origin.

changelog.change: Acquisition recipe registered; this is now the only supported way to fetch it.
Reference republished at res-05 and res-25 (+ unsuffixed alias = res-05); livestock constant-I$ rows had held nominal values (1.198 -> 1.000 vs FAOSTAT); unit column carries the vintage.
Republished on the revised nominal crop price method; constant-I$ unchanged.
Republished: FAOSTAT joins keyed on item code; constant-I$ crop side 200.28 -> 240.24 B (+20 %).

Republished: livestock nominal-usd-2021 rows priced at national producer prices (104.23 -> 109.06 B at res-25); every other row value-identical. Linked cdh_record (res-05 sibling: africa-exposure-combined-res05).

acquire.note: Computed by the pipeline, not downloaded. Listed so the catalogue names one reproducible command per dataset.
